text: Always ensure that the import paths are correct and that all necessary modules are imported before running tests, as missing imports can lead to NameErrors and prevent tests from executing properly.

When writing tests, make sure to verify that the test case is actually testing the intended behavior by checking the state of the system at the buggy commit, rather than relying solely on the test passing or failing.
Always verify the correct import paths and available attributes in the modules being tested, as incorrect imports can lead to AttributeError exceptions.
Ensure that the test fixtures are correctly set up and that the expected API shapes are being used, as mismatches can cause tests to fail before reaching the intended behavior.
